title: hotfix: tighten SLO enforcer backoff thresholds to prevent regional thrashing
author: Priya Nair
description:
Context: During a regional capacity fluctuation on 2026-02-09 we observed repeated regional failovers and immediate re-failovers (thrashing) driven by the SLO enforcer backoff and hysteresis configuration. The enforcer was allowing short backoff windows which, combined with bursty request arrivals and asymmetric regional capacity, caused routes to flip between regions and triggered excessive load-shedding and error spikes.

Summary: This hotfix tightens backoff base durations, increases hysteresis windows, and adds bounded jitter to reduce synchronized retry waves. The changes are intentionally conservative and configurable via thresholds.yaml so we can tune post-deploy. Key changes: (1) increase base backoff from 1s to 5s, (2) add exponential cap to backoff (max 60s), (3) add per-route cooldown (min 15s) to prevent immediate re-evaluation, (4) introduce jitter +-20% to avoid synchronized retries, (5) smooth queue hysteresis to require sustained breach for 2 evaluation windows before triggering failover, (6) add unit + integration tests that simulate regional failover and verify non-thrashing behavior.

Files changed: small, focused set (enforcer logic, thresholds config, tests, docs). No API surface changes. This addresses ENG-2103 and ENG-2106; related support ticket SUP-4521.

Testing: added deterministic unit tests for backoff increment/cap, fuzz tests for jitter distribution, and an integration scenario in perf-canary that simulates asymmetric regional capacity and validates route stability over a 10-minute window. CI run was green after a single re-run of flaky perf test.

Rollback plan: configuration can be toggled via SSM/feature-flag; thresholds.yaml supports runtime reload. If unexpected regressions occur, revert commit or disable feature flag and redeploy.

Checklist:
- [x] reproduce thrashing locally and in perf environment
- [x] implement conservative thresholds and jitter
- [x] add unit/integration tests
- [x] documentation and runbook updates
- [x] CI green and manual perf validation

Notes: This is a production hotfix targeting immediate stability. We will follow up with workload-specific tuning and telemetry dashboards to track hysteresis/failover counts per-route.
